newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks seen firmer on Wall Street rally.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks seen firmer on Wall Street rally.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are seen firmer on Friday following a higher overnight close on Wall Street, but arbitrage orders are expected to keep the blue chip index within a range, brokers said.
"The market should rise today with the index edging up about 50 to 100 points after a rebound of U.S. stocks," said Andrew To, dealing director, OSK Asia Securities.
The Hang Seng Index eased 36.06 points to close at 14,795.52 on Thursday. The Hang Seng London Reference index later added 22.77 points to close at 14,818.29.
